activeRisks.title: High Risk of Merge Conflict
activeRisks.description: 3 developers (Sarah Chen, Mike Rodriguez, Priya Sharma) are simultaneously modifying the same complex Dashboard component. Current implementation has 450+ lines in a single file with tightly coupled state management.
activeRisks.estimatedImpact: 8 hours of conflict resolution, potential sprint delay

activeRisks.title: Performance Degradation in Data Grid
activeRisks.description: Rendering 10,000+ rows without virtualization causing browser lag. User complaints increasing in production environment.
activeRisks.estimatedImpact: Poor user experience, potential customer escalations

activeRisks.title: Deprecated API Usage
activeRisks.description: Using legacy authentication endpoint scheduled for deprecation in Q3 2026. Migration path available but not yet implemented.
activeRisks.estimatedImpact: Service disruption if not migrated before Q3

agentProposals.title: Decompose Monolithic Dashboard Component
agentProposals.businessImpact: Unblocks 3 developers. Eliminates persistent merge conflicts. Saves 12 estimated hours of refactoring.
